title: Keep the Source Sans 3 license byte-identical in Git (line-ending correction)
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: The repository's '* text=auto eol=lf' rule committed an LF copy of the Source Sans 3 LICENSE.md in 17b7b8f, while the font manifest records the upstream CRLF bytes (sha256 89ad2c...). A fresh checkout would fail the font provenance test. .gitattributes now marks that one file -text and the committed blob is the exact upstream bytes.

RUN-20261020-028 (configuration contract, typecheck, lint, full suite: 399 Node, 24 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection) and RUN-20261020-029 (Chromium 150/150) pass at the final fingerprint 89f989ca. The local isolated pipeline was not re-run: RUN-20261020-026 passed all 15 stages one fingerprint earlier and only this attribute changed; the hosted run on a real checkout covers the fix.
